label: unresolved relation meaning
definition: The complete relation dictionary and argument roles do not identify a coherent dominant predicate whose facts can be judged without inventing a scope.
scope_notes: Includes: explicitly documented relation-level semantic indeterminacy after complete dictionary and argument-role inspection. Excludes: using ambiguity to omit difficult facts or change denominators; a broad association or disjunction invented to make unrelated meanings correct; using this marker when a coherent dominant family can be identified. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: all facts remain ambiguous because the relation meaning is unresolved. This is an evaluation marker, not a learned semantic relation. Every fact receives A with a case-specific question; retain all facts in denominators and separately report relation-semantic-indeterminacy counts.
